description: Write entries from the database into config/sync with the plugin's own export — the exact form config-sync compares, so the files stop showing as different. Only entries that differ are exported; `keys` narrows it (default: every difference). An entry only in config/sync has its file deleted. Commit the files with the code that caused them. It runs the project's code: Strapi is loaded the way config-sync's own CLI does (no server, no port, no admin account), and a load does what a start of `strapi develop` does to the database (schema sync, pending migrations) — so only on a local development database: a remote one, a Strapi 4 database under Strapi 5 code, or a missing SQLite file are refused before Strapi's bootstrap (where it writes to the database).

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

keys.description: The entries to export (default: every difference).

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

name: config_sync_export
title: config-sync: export entries from the database into config/sync
